Site.Name: heart of the Foldscar
Site.DoneText: The heart holds. The ring goes quiet all at once, and across it Tavar's shadow catches up with him.
Site.LockedText: It slides out from under your hand. Somewhere in the ring a Quiet Stone is still out of line.

Site.Name: north Quiet Stone
Site.DoneText: The stone grinds a hand's width round and stops, square to the ring. The air beside it goes still.

Site.Name: south-east Quiet Stone
Site.DoneText: The stone comes round into line. For a moment your shadow points two ways, then one.

Site.Name: south-west Quiet Stone
Site.DoneText: The stone turns with a sound that arrives a moment late, and settles square to the ring.

Site.Prompt: Tavar Orr, half a breath out of true - your hand stops short of him
